# iOS Emojis

> A lightweight browser tool for finding and copying Apple-style emojis on Android.

## Pages

- [Emoji library](https://iosemojis.com/): Search and browse the emoji collection.
- [How it works](https://iosemojis.com/guide): Instructions for copying emoji text and images.
- [About](https://iosemojis.com/about): Project and creator information.

## Usage

Users may browse categories, search emoji names, and copy an emoji as text or an image. The service does not require an account.
